steps.title: Prepare 165 kb Ladder Aliquots
steps.instruction: Prepare and store aliquots of the 165 kb Ladder to prevent degradation.

substeps.instruction: Thaw the 165 kb ladder tube slowly on ice and briefly spin down.
Using provided wide-bore genomic tips and Eppendorf LoBind 0.5 mL tubes, aliquot the 165 kb Ladder solution into 7 aliquots of 5 µL each.
Store aliquots at -20 °C (Note: avoid freeze-thawing more than 4 times).

steps.title: Prepare 165 kb Ladder Working Solution
steps.instruction: Create the working solution for the ladder using specific buffers and mixing techniques.

substeps.instruction: Thaw a 5 µL ladder aliquot slowly on ice and spin down; mix very slowly by pipetting two times with a wide-bore genomic pipette tip (pipettor set to 5 µL).
In a provided Eppendorf LoBind 0.5 mL tube, aliquot 9 µL of DNF-498 0.25x TE Dilution Buffer and 90 µL of FP-8001 gDNA Diluent Marker solution, then mix by vortexing.
Using a regular pipette tip, immediately aliquot 1 µL of the mixed 165 kb Ladder into the tube containing the 99 µL buffer mixture. Do not pipette-mix or vortex.
Using a wide-bore genomic pipette tip (pipettor set to 20 µL), slowly pipette the prepared working solution up and down 5 times to mix. Use within one day.

steps.title: Prepare System Solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers and gels for the Femto Pulse system.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1x Conditioning Solution: Combine 40 mL distilled, nuclease-free water with 10 mL 5x Conditioning Solution in a Falcon tube; invert to mix. Fill the system tube and update the solution level in the application. Store excess at Room temperature.

Prepare FP Large DNA Separation Gel: Combine Separation Gel and Intercalating Dye in a Falcon tube according to the volume specifications (Initial 1.0 µL dye and 10 mL gel, adding 1.0 µL dye and 10 mL gel for every 10 samples). Invert gently to mix. Store at 4 °C and protect from light (stable for 2-3 weeks).
Prepare 1x Inlet Buffer: Combine 40 mL distilled water with 10 mL 5x Inlet Buffer stock in a Falcon tube. Aliquot 1.0 mL per well into Row A (replace daily).
Prepare Row H: Aliquot 1.0 mL of Capillary Storage Solution per well (replace weekly).
Prepare Row A (Rinse): Aliquot 200 µL of 0.25x TE Rinse Buffer per well (replace daily).
Prepare Diluent Marker aliquots: Divide new tubes into ~1 mL aliquots in 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes. Vortex and spin down. Limit room temperature exposure to one hour.

steps.title: Prepare Sample Plate
steps.instruction: Dilute and load gDNA samples and ladders into the 96-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Dilute samples using distilled, nuclease-free water or 0.25x TE dilution buffer: use 500 pg/µL for wide distributions (HMW gDNA) or 250 pg/µL for uniform distributions (sheared DNA/libraries).
For Drawer B (deep well) or Drawer M (semi-skirted), pipette 18 µL of FP-8001 gDNA Diluent Marker (DM) into each sample well.
Pipette 2 µL of each gDNA sample into the 18 µL of DM. Mix by pipetting up and down three times using wide-bore genomic pipette tips.
Load 20 µL of the 165 kb Ladder Working Solution into Well 12 and any other designated backup ladder wells. Mix the ladder up and down three times using wide-bore tips (pipettor set to 20 µL).
Fill any unused wells in the row with 20 µL of BF-P25 Blank Solution (light sensitive).
Centrifuge the plate to remove air bubbles from the bottom of the wells.

steps.title: System Setup and Conditioning
steps.instruction: Initialize the instrument and perform daily conditioning.

substeps.instruction: Place plates into their corresponding drawers.
Visually inspect and confirm solution levels of intercalating dye, separation gel, and 1x Conditioning solution in the tubes.
Select the '20 min Conditioning' method from the dropdown menu, press OK to add to queue, and press the green Play icon to start (performs 20 min flush and 3 min gel fill).

steps.title: Run Samples
steps.instruction: Load the prepared plate and execute the analysis.

substeps.instruction: Place the plate in one of the sample plate trays (Drawers 4-6, labelled 1, 2, or 3).
Run immediately or store at 2 °C to 8 °C with cover film.
In the application, select Row, Group, or Tray to run; input sample names and locations of ladders and blanks.
Select 'Add to Queue' and choose the method based on capillary length: 'FP-1002-22 – gDNA 165kb' or 'FP-1002E-22 – Extended gDNA 165kb' (preferred).
Press the green Play icon to start the run.

steps.title: Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Verify the ladder and generate sample size information.

substeps.instruction: Ensure the ladder for each row is properly labelled and matches the ideal extended gDNA 165 kb ladder profile.
Right-click to add or delete detected peaks and choose 'Accept change' to confirm. Once the ladder is accepted, sample size information will be generated.
